inputs.text: Seamless flat ground texture for a 2D top-down video game, seen from directly above, orthographic, uniform pattern filling the whole image edge to edge: calm stream water surface in blue-green (#8FB8BE) evenly mixed with deeper teal (#6F9CA6), many small soft horizontal ripple strokes evenly spread, a few tiny cream glints. transparent watercolor washes on light cold-press paper, soft granulation, subtle pigment pooling, muted warm palette, even soft lighting with no cast shadows, no ink lines. No objects, no border, no horizon, no perspective, no text.
低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲. photo, photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colors, text, letters, watermark, signature
